# Business and economics

> The front page of a family of repositories on business and economics: the business a venture needs, the economics that serves it, and behavioural economics. The map, the shared words, and the rule of one repository per problem with nothing private. Scope only.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [Business and economics](https://tewf.github.io/business/README.md): the scope, the first job and the questions its review must answer
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/business/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/business/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics/standard.md): the reader-ergonomics card this repository obeys
